entries.reason: Normaliser rows N1 and N3-N6: Demo Factory stores a canonical {name, rules} set; producing the other stored shapes needs a non-canonical write to production, which LIVE-TESTING §4 forbids.

The read-modify-write helpers refuse a stored document that is not {name, rules}; Demo Factory stores a canonical set and producing another shape needs a non-canonical write to production, which LIVE-TESTING §4 forbids.

setRuleEnabled(…, true) deletes the disabled key and so enables a rule; enabling a rule in production exceeds the one disabled test entry LIVE-TESTING §4.2 allows (P5 §9.7). Unit test R5 'true → the disabled key is deleted (not false)'.
